THE FULL DEFAULT SELECTION IS NOW GREEN — this is the one criterion the completion verifier correctly
refused to accept on the previous close attempt, and it was RIGHT to refuse.

The prior record on this ticket said, honestly: "The FULL default selection did NOT complete. Not a
failure: this host is saturated by other agents... the full-selection exit code is still owed before
either ticket closes." A targeted regression run (168 passed) covered only the affected set. That is not
what the AC asks for, and the verifier caught the gap rather than accepting a subset. Now paid off:

  RUN: pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 6 --dist worksteal -q -p no:cacheprovider
  TREE: afc99e250, working tree CLEAN (git status --porcelain empty, asserted BEFORE the run so the
        result is evidence about this commit and not about uncommitted scratch)
  RESULT: 9374 passed, 41 skipped, 1 xfailed, 17 warnings in 439.45s (7m19s)
  EXIT CODE: 0        <- judged by exit code, not by reading the summary line
  Alongside it, same tree, same clean state, all by exit code:
    make lint = 0 · make typecheck = 0 · scripts/check_config_reads.py = 0 · gen_env_registry.py --check = 0

WHY THIS TREE IS VALID EVIDENCE FOR 9ac2, stated explicitly rather than left implicit: afc99e250
differs from origin/main by exactly ONE commit, which touches only docs/local-dev-env.md — a markdown
file. It cannot affect test outcomes. 9ac2s fix (76ab5cebd) is merged into origin/main and is therefore
present in this tree. So a green full selection here is a green full selection over the merged fix.

Of specific relevance to this ticket and b718: no order-dependent failure appeared.
tests/unit/test_agent_call_seam.py::test_success_telemetry_survives_an_empty_usage_dict — the
StopIteration failure whose CAUSE b718 and 9ac2 fixed — passed within the full parallel selection, which
is the run shape that used to expose it. The fail-closed caplog guard did not itself introduce any new
failure across 9374 tests.
